title: GREAT: A Graph Edge Attention Network for the Electric Vehicle Routing Problem with Asymmetric Costs
abstract: arXiv:2408.16717v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Due to the ongoing electrification of transportation systems, energy-based routing problems such as the Electric Vehicle Routing Problem (EVRP) are becoming increasingly important. Unlike Euclidean routing problems, the EVRP involves asymmetric energy costs caused by road topology. Existing learning-based routing approaches are based on graph neural networks (GNNs) or transformer architectures operating on Euclidean node coordinates, making them poorly suited for asymmetric, non-Euclidean edge-based metrics such as energy consumption. To address this, we propose the Graph Edge Attention Network (GREAT), a novel GNN-related architecture that operates purely in edge space rather than on node coordinates, making it naturally compatible with asymmetric routing costs. Integrated into an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework, GREAT jointly optimizes routing and charging decisions for the EVRP. We train the model using real-worl

translated_title: GREAT：一种用于非对称成本电动汽车路径问题的图边注意力网络
translated_abstract: 由于交通系统的持续电气化，诸如电动汽车路径问题（EVRP）等基于能耗的路径规划问题正变得日益重要。与欧几里得路径规划问题不同，EVRP涉及由道路拓扑结构引起的非对称能耗成本。现有的基于学习的路径规划方法依赖于图神经网络（GNN）或基于欧几里得节点坐标运行的Transformer架构，因此难以适用于如能耗这类非对称的、非欧几里得的基于边的度量指标。为解决这一问题，我们提出了图边注意力网络（GREAT），这是一种新颖的GNN相关架构，完全在边空间而非节点坐标上运行，使其天然兼容非对称路径成本。GREAT被集成到端到端强化学习框架中，可联合优化EVRP的路径规划与充电决策。我们使用真实世界的数据对模型进行训练……
tldr: 本文提出在边空间而非节点坐标上运行的图边注意力网络GREAT，天然兼容道路拓扑导致的非对称能耗成本，并通过端到端强化学习联合优化电动汽车的路径规划与充电决策。
en_tdlr: GREAT, a novel graph edge attention network operating purely in edge space rather than node coordinates, is naturally compatible with asymmetric energy costs and jointly optimizes routing and charging decisions for the EVRP via an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework.
